title: ⚡ GTA 6 LAUNCH WEEK COULD MAKE GAMING HISTORY — ROCKSTAR WORKERS TO VOTE!
description: Rockstar Games employees in the UK are preparing for a historic union recognition vote scheduled between November 12 and November 26. The voting period will overlap with GTA VI's November 19 launch. The decision could give employees a collective voice on pay, overtime, job security, flexible working and other workplace policies.
article_content:
While millions of players prepare for Grand Theft Auto VI, Rockstar Games is approaching another major milestone behind the scenes.

Rockstar employees in the United Kingdom are scheduled to vote on whether to formally recognize the IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union. The voting period will run from November 12 through November 26, 2026.

Interestingly, the vote will overlap with the highly anticipated November 19 launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.

If employees approve union recognition, the agreement could give workers a stronger collective voice in discussions involving pay, bonuses, overtime, redundancies, flexible working arrangements and generative AI policies.

The vote follows months of discussions between workers and management. It also comes amid an ongoing employment dispute involving former employees who were dismissed in 2025. Rockstar has denied allegations that those dismissals were connected to union-organizing activities.

A successful vote could represent an important development for the UK gaming industry, potentially establishing one of its largest recognized video game sector unions.

🗳️ Union Voting: November 12–26, 2026
🎮 GTA VI Launch: November 19, 2026
👥 Organization: IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union
📋 Focus: Pay, Bonuses, Overtime and Workplace Policies
